notes: Fixed four defects in managent acceptance machinery: (1) signal-killed commands reported PASS — switch on Child.Term union now catches .signal/.stopped/.unknown; (2) deliverables= parser swallowed subsequent key= tokens — now truncates at next key= pattern; (3) --skip-acceptance accepted empty reason — now rejects zero-length; (4) acceptance and skip_acceptance_reason fields were read from JSON but never written — added to writeState serialization. Regression tests in tools/regression-T227.sh: 3/3 passing. Also added deploy-managent build step to keep bin/managent in sync with zig-out.
